title: OK For Light Use
text:
OK For Light Use. Once again another disappointing appliance. I already have a T-Fal fryer that is awesome. I got this one for those times when you want some more fryer space when entertaining. I knew right out of the box that it wasn't as nice as the one I have. Not nearly as heavy. Could be due to the fact that this one doesn't have an oil reservoir and has to be drained into the bottle after use. Nice digital controls that are really not necessary. If you are frying and setting a time that's not a good thing. Best to always be paying attention to what is in the fryer. I make a lot of potato chips. The directions in the book for this machine say to cook them for 17 minutes. Really!? Talk about burnt to a crisp.

The plug to this is magnetic, like my other one, but this plug won't stay in at all. Barely makes connection and the slightest bump makes it fall out. Not as deep as I was expecting and doesn't hold as much oil either.

The little door that opens in the front to drain the oil is cheap.

It cleans up easily, but I will only be using it on rare occasions. Bottom line, get a T-fal. Better machine.

product_metadata.title: De'Longhi Livenza Dual Zone Easy Clean Deep Fryer, 18 x 11 x 12.5 inches, Silver
features: EASY DRAINING: Leftover oil is quickly and easily removed with the EasyClean draining system.
LARGER COOL ZONE: Food particles drop into the large cool zone keeping the oil cleaner with less odor.
LONGER-LASTING OIL: The lower temperature of the cool zone extends the use of oil by 20% – which amounts to a considerable cost savings.
NO-HASSLE CLEANUP: In addition to the EasyClean System, the dishwasher-safe parts allow you to enjoy stress-free cleanup.
COOK FOR A CROWD: The large, 1-gallon oil capacity lets you fry larger quantities for friends, family and even parties
FROM THE FRYER TO THE PLATE: The removable basket makes it easy and safe to take sizzling food out of the oil.
COMPLETE CONTROL: The adjustable thermostat gives you the power to prepare foods exactly the way you like them.
BUILT TO LAST: The solid stainless steel construction is equally matched by its timeless, durable design.
LIGHT AND CRISPY: Less oil is absorbed into food, leaving you with light and crispy mouthwatering bites.
description: The De’Longhi Livenza Deep Fryer with EasyClean System, model D44528DZ, makes it easy to cook for a larger family or entertain a crowd. The featured EasyClean System makes the cleaning process a cinch with an integrated spout that allows you to drain oil directly from the fryer, without ever having to touch it. The new Livenza Deep Fryer also offers an increased oil capacity of up to 1 gallon along with a unique “Cool Zone” area so your oil stays 20% cleaner with less odor and less oil absorbed into the food. The Livenza Deep Fryer also features an adjustable thermometer that allows you to cook delicious food like fried chicken, fresh donuts and even tempura vegetables evenly and efficiently every time. The removable basket makes it easy and safe to pull your sizzling treats out of the oil and enjoy immediately.
